label: Figure 20.1: Demand-pull inflation
alt: AD/AS diagram: aggregate demand shifts right from AD1 to AD2 along the upward-sloping SRAS curve, raising the price level from P1 to P2 and real output from Y1 to Y2.
caption: An increase in aggregate demand from AD<sub>1</sub> to AD<sub>2</sub> moves the economy up along the SRAS curve. The average price level rises from P<sub>1</sub> to P<sub>2</sub> and real output rises from Y<sub>1</sub> to Y<sub>2</sub>.
